subject: FOCUS DECISION: restore evergreen current-main build signal
body: WORKSTREAM_ID=ws-reviewer-ci-source-of-truth-20261002. WORKSTREAM_STATE=FOCUS_SELECTED_NOT_YET_CLAIMED. STARTING_MAIN_SHA=7a612a0fe3181768f548a1ec78d2c3ee5938a339. Live board is legacy v1; CURRENT_STATE confirms runtime 2.0.2-zfold7-gen2-field1/versionCode 37 and Gen3 Alpha1 not yet committed. DISCOVERY_INVENTORY: (1) CI_SOURCE_OF_TRUTH_LIFECYCLE score=23 [IMPACT=4: every main push triggers a legacy replay job that currently fails before compile and app-changing pushes also trigger a direct-source job pinned to 1.3.25; EVIDENCE_DEFICIT=1: current run logs are already decisive; ARCHITECTURAL_LEVERAGE=4: one CI policy boundary can separate historical migration workflows from evergreen current-source validation; VALIDATION_TRACTABILITY=3: workflow/static and recent-run validation are cheap; SYMPTOM_RELEVANCE=4: current main has red Actions on each push and no dependable current-source build signal; PRIMARY_NEED=3: Gen3 successor handoff explicitly depends on trustworthy focused/full Gradle gates; DUPLICATION=0: absent from ACTIVE_FUTURE_STATE and new state-rd claims; BLOCKER=0]. (2) SHELL_PHYSICAL_ID_CACHE_REVALIDATION score=21 [5,4,4,1,2,2,0,2]: cached physical IDs are never revalidated inside a long-lived shell process, but compositor-restart behavior is device/AOSP-evidence heavy. (3) TRANSITION_LAB_SELF_PERTURBATION score=19 [3,5,3,2,2,2,0,1]: debug FULL_LAB records on main/control paths and writer overhead has not been measured, but production release is OFF. (4) ACCESSIBILITY_VS_FOREGROUND_RUNTIME_LIFECYCLE score=16 [4,4,3,1,2,2,1,2]: foreground service is START_STICKY but controller lives in AccessibilityService; decisive reconnection behavior needs device lifecycle evidence. (5) DEVICE_STATE_REFLECTION_COMPATIBILITY score=14 [3,4,2,2,2,1,1,1]: hidden DeviceState reflection has no direct test but overlaps semantic-reclose work and is lower leverage. (6) DISPLAY_SYNC_DEBOUNCE_STARVATION score=13 [3,2,3,2,2,1,2,0]: heavy engine sync can be postponed by callback storms, but continuity fast-lane already handles core ownership/readiness. FOCUS_DECISION_RECORD: select #1 as TEST_GAP/ARCHITECTURE_GAP. Confirmed evidence: workflow run 36941681570 fails at step 'Replay last successful Fold7 geometry build' because historical source hash expectations no longer match current main; build-shizuku-apk.yml runs on every push to main and reconstructs old steps from commit fc417509.... Separately, build-direct-fold7.yml is named 1.3.25 and hard-greps versionCode=30/versionName=1.3.25; its recent run 36917572325 fails in that validation before Gradle. Dominant hypothesis: historical apply/replay workflows have become CI jobs, so red status now means expected source drift rather than current code failure. Cheapest decisive action: classify current workflows by intent/trigger, prove which push-triggered jobs are evergreen vs historical, then produce a no-production-write patch proposal that makes the historical replay manual-only and makes the direct-source build version-agnostic/current-source authoritative.
